integrity: Equations proved analytically; exact-rational finite checker is corroborative, not an exhaustive infinite proof. Literature comparisons are based on identified inspected material.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification is restricted to nonempty two-cluster phase-locked states and complete-graph repeated-index asymmetric triad with K1,K2>0 and identical frequencies; other attractors, graph topologies and disordered frequencies are not classified. Historical priority provisional; no independent validation.
title: A sharp six-oscillator ceiling for attracting antipodal states under repeated-index triadic coupling
